facts: Dr. Eda Jokic is the dentist named on official site; NYU DDS graduated 2014.
Born in Tirana, Albania and completed dental studies in Bulgaria before further training in the US.
Official biography lists general and cosmetic dentistry, implants, Invisalign and surgery.
Biography states fluent Albanian, Serbian and Bulgarian, proficient Italian and Spanish.
Current homepage says walk-ins welcome during regular business hours.
opportunities: Homepage hero still describes emergency-only COVID-era care and preparing to resume normal business hours, alongside walk-in messaging.
Large navigation contains dozens of treatments and generic education links; clearer patient pathways could help visitors find relevant care.
Give Dr. Jokic and practical visit information more prominence, with a simple call/request route.
